files.description: Feature review rubric: the questions every product change is checked against for behavior, UI, reuse, architecture, code, and tests, plus known escapes.
Architecture principles: where business rules live and how capabilities, interfaces, and shared foundations depend on each other.
Which layer owns a web feature change: views, controllers, data adapters, interface server code.
How to choose the owning test layer, avoid duplicated coverage, and test behavior rather than implementation.
Coding conventions for abstraction level, function size, readability, and safety.
Shared components and patterns to reuse when composing screens.
